text:
### Exception Process  
1. Document reason for exception
2. Escalate to Compliance Head
3. Compliance Head reviews and decides:
- Approve (with additional conditions)
- Request alternative verification
- Reject (account application denied)
4. Decision recorded in system

raw_entities.name: Exception Process
raw_entities.description: An end-to-end procedure for handling exceptions during account application workflows. The process requires documentation of the exception reason, escalation to the Compliance Head for review and decision, and system recording of the outcome. Three decision paths are available: approval with conditions, request for alternative verification, or rejection.

raw_entities.name: Document Exception Reason
raw_entities.description: The initial step in the exception process where the reason for the exception is formally documented. This creates the record that will be escalated for compliance review.

raw_entities.name: Escalate to Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The documented exception is escalated to the Compliance Head for formal review and decision-making. This step transfers ownership from the initial documenting role to senior compliance authority.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head Exception Review and Decision
raw_entities.description: The Compliance Head reviews the documented exception and makes a binding decision on how to proceed. Three distinct outcomes are possible: approval with additional conditions, request for alternative verification, or rejection of the account application.

raw_entities.name: Record Decision in System
raw_entities.description: The Compliance Head's decision and rationale are formally recorded in the system. This creates an audit trail and ensures the decision is available for future reference and compliance reporting.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head Exception Decision Gate
raw_entities.description: A three-way decision gate where the Compliance Head determines the outcome of the exception review. The decision branches into approval with conditions, request for alternative verification, or rejection of the account application.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: The senior compliance authority responsible for reviewing documented exceptions and making binding decisions on account applications. The Compliance Head has authority to approve with conditions, request alternative verification, or reject applications.

raw_entities.name: Exception Documenting Officer
raw_entities.description: The role responsible for documenting the reason for an exception in the initial step of the exception process. This role prepares the exception record for escalation to the Compliance Head.
